paint.name: エビ
paint.desc: (仮・パイプラインの試し) a small cheerful shrimp creature shaped like a piece of ebi nigiri sushi: a glossy orange-red shrimp body lying on a soft white rice-ball body, big round friendly eyes, tiny arms, long curling antennae, standing on two little feet; welcoming and chatty
